- Package: `@supabase/supabase-js@2.117.2`, MIT license (see `supabase-LICENSE`).
- Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/@supabase/supabase-js/-/supabase-js-2.117.2.tgz

- Browser file SHA-256: `59d39487c3589843b410322d8a3d562ce022aba1e5ccb16898ef3fb2a0da2ecd`.

Pinned and served locally; no runtime CDN dependency. Only Realtime Presence is
used. Auth persistence, URL session detection and token refresh are disabled,
so this client never reads the administrator's login session.
